mapper.insert:
insert into ${tableName} ( primary_key, position, stock, enterprise_code, operation_num, check_batch_number, batch_code, remark, operator, operation_type, operation_time, material, detail_code, apply_num, operation_version, check_version, batch_global_code, apply_detail_code, stock_type, contract_number, contract_code, related_party, parent_material_data_key, warehouse_stock_detail_code ) VALUES
( #{model.positionOperationCode}, #{model.position}, #{model.stock}, #{model.enterpriseCode}, #{model.operationNum}, #{model.checkBatchNumber}, #{model.batchCode}, #{model.remark}, #{model.operator}, #{model.operationType}, #{model.operationTime}, #{model.material}, #{model.detailCode}, #{model.applyNum}, #{model.operationVersion}, #{model.checkVersion}, #{model.batchGlobalCode}, #{model.applyDetailCode}, #{model.stockType}, #{model.contractNumber}, #{model.contractCode}, #{model.relatedParty}, #{model.parentMaterialDataKey}, #{model.warehouseStockDetailCode} )
mapper.select: select t.apply_num, t.operation_num, t1.position_sign, t.check_batch_number, t.operator, t.operation_time, t.remark, t.primary_key as positionOperationCode, t.operation_version, t.operation_time from ${positionOperationTableName} t inner join ${positionTableName} t1 on t.position = t1.primary_key where t.enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} and t.detail_code = #{code} order by t.create_time desc

select t.apply_num, t.operation_num, t1.position_sign, t.check_batch_number, t.operator, t.operation_time, t.remark, t.primary_key as positionOperationCode, t.operation_version, t.operation_time from ${positionOperationTableName} t inner join ${positionTableName} t1 on t.position = t1.primary_key where t.enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} and t.operation_version = #{operationVersion} order by t.create_time desc

select t.apply_num, t.operation_num, t1.position_sign, t.check_batch_number, t.operator, t.operation_time, t.remark, t.primary_key as positionOperationCode, t.operation_version, t.operation_time from ${positionOperationTableName} t inner join ${positionTableName} t1 on t.position = t1.primary_key where t.enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} and t.warehouse_stock_detail_code = #{warehouseStockDetailCode} order by t.create_time desc

select t.apply_num, t.operation_num, t.check_batch_number, t.operator, t.operation_time, t.remark, t.primary_key as positionOperationCode, t.operation_version, t.operation_time from ${dynamicTableNameProxy.positionOperation} t where apply_detail_code = #{id} order by t.operation_time desc nulls last
